panel.waitingWith: Payment by {way} started {date} · waiting for the bank
panel.waitingPlain: An online payment started {date} · waiting for the bank

notice.draft: Send the invoice first. A payment can only be recorded against a sent invoice.
notice.private: Customers cannot reach this server, so pay links are off. You can still record payments.
notice.noAddress: This server has no public address yet, so pay links are off. Set it as “Address in email links” in Senders. You can still record payments.
notice.update: This invoice table needs its app's update to take online payments.
notice.voided: This invoice was voided. No payment can be taken.
notice.noCurrency: This record has no currency, so no payment can be recorded.
notice.unclear: The amount of this record is not exact in its currency, so no payment can be recorded.
notice.notPayable: This record cannot take a payment right now.

by.card: by card on our own terminal

toast.replaced: A new pay link replaces the one made on {date}.
toast.revoked: Pay link revoked. The old address no longer works.
toast.copyFailed: The pay link is made, but this browser would not copy it: {url}
toast.emailed: The pay link is on its way to {to}.

why.pending: This payment is still waiting for the bank.
why.offline: This way to pay cannot be refunded online. Refund the customer by hand.
why.disputed: This payment is disputed. Answer the dispute in the {service} dashboard first.
why.notTaken: No money was taken for this payment.

panel.disputeLine: Disputed — answer it in the {service} dashboard
panel.disputeNote: If the dispute is lost, the money goes back to the customer. The invoice is not changed by itself.
panel.disputeClosed: The dispute was closed. Its outcome is in the {service} dashboard.
panel.refundWaitingCustomer: Refund of {amount} is waiting for the customer
panel.refundFailed: The refund of {amount} failed: {reason}. Contact the customer and record what you agree.
panel.refundFailedPlain: The refund of {amount} failed. Contact the customer and record what you agree.
panel.refundedThere: Refund of {amount} made in the {service} dashboard on {date} · recorded

record.title: Record a payment
record.approvalErr: Use letters and digits only, up to 12.
record.last4Err: Enter the last four digits only.
record.cardNumber: This looks like a full card number. Never write card numbers here.
record.overDue: That is more than the {amount} that is due.
record.dateErr: The day it was paid cannot be in the future.
record.pendingWarn: An online payment is waiting for the bank. Recording another one may take the money twice.

look.title: A payment needs a look
look.titleTest: A test payment needs a look
look.amount: Paid at {provider}, not the amount asked: {label}
look.voided: Paid at {provider} after it was voided: {label}
look.mode: Paid at {provider} in the other mode, not believed: {label}
look.missing: Its recorded payment is no longer there: {label}
look.refundedThere: Refunded in the {provider} dashboard: {amount} on {label}. Recorded.

key.title: {provider} refused the key
key.body: Payments are paused until a working key is saved.

webhook.title: The {provider} webhook is silent
webhook.body: No event since {date}. Payments are found by asking, more slowly.
webhook.bodyNever: No live event has arrived yet. Payments are found by asking, more slowly.

reads.title: Adminium checks {provider} less often
reads.body: It has used half of the reads {provider} allows this month.

keysRemoved.title: The {provider} keys were removed
keysRemoved.body: By {by}. No payment starts with {provider} until new keys are saved.

redirect.account: A payment key now belongs to another account
redirect.bank: The bank details for bank transfers changed

refund.title: Refund a payment
refund.goesBackPlain: Goes back the way it was paid. Usually 5–10 days.
refund.question: Refund {amount} to {paidWith}?
refund.lost: No answer came back. Press Refund again: it asks for the same refund, never a second one.
